lines.text: A fake doctor performed sixteen successful warship surgeries without losing one patient.
And he had zero days of medical training.
In nineteen fifty-one, Canadian warship HMCS Cayuga needed an emergency surgeon.
Ferdinand Demara stole a real doctor's credentials and volunteered for duty.
When sixteen critically wounded soldiers were rushed into his operating room...
He locked himself in his cabin and speed-read surgical handbooks overnight.
He removed bullets, extracted shrapnel, and amputated limbs flawlessly.
The Canadian Navy praised him as a national medical hero.
Until the real doctor's mother read the newspaper in total shock.
The navy was so embarrassed they let him walk away free.
Because even without a medical license, this legendary con artist...
